headline: Nothing is locked yet this morning — move Caleb Williams (Out, hamstring) to IR now and start Geno Smith at superflex before you forget.
summary: Danny is 1-1 and a 6.5-point favorite on paper over KUZ1 (0-2) this week if the lineup is fixed. The one must-do is finishing Monday's plan: Williams is IR-eligible and unlocked right now, so move him and slot in Geno Smith. Nabers and Jones are both Questionable but trending toward playing — set their auto-subs by Sunday 10 AM PT as insurance, and grab Miami's new de facto WR1 for the empty bench spot the IR move creates.

lineup.why: Williams is Out with a hamstring injury and Bears coach Ben Johnson called him week-to-week on Sept 21; Geno Smith is NYJ's clear starter this week.
lineup.evidence: Caleb Williams: carted off Sept 20 vs MIN, coach Ben Johnson (Sept 21) said week-to-week and did not rule him out for wk3 but a sports-medicine physician expects 4-8 weeks; room confirms Out/Hamstring, T. Bagent is Chicago's QB2. Geno Smith: room shows him NYJ QB1 outright, 31.4 projected pass attempts Sun 10 AM @ DET as a 6.5-point underdog.

adds.why: tier 3 bench stash, bid 3 of your budget: Miami released Tyreek Hill and Washington now sits atop the Dolphins' WR depth chart, but the offense (Malik Willis at QB) is weak so he's bench depth, not a start.
adds.evidence: Room shows M. Washington WR1 for MIA; multiple Sept reports (Phinsider, PhinPhanatic) confirm Washington is Miami's clear top receiver after Hill's release, with backup C. Douglas (Questionable, ankle) behind him. Danny's only other bench WR is Quentin Johnston, so this is pure insurance, not a starter swap. The freed roster spot comes from the Caleb Williams IR move above, not a drop.

ir.why: Out with a hamstring injury (week-to-week per Sept 21 Bears presser), IR-eligible now, and nothing is locked yet this morning so the move and the roster spot it frees are available immediately — don't wait for Tuesday lock, it's already Tuesday and unlocked.

subs.why: Nabers is Questionable (shoulder popped out Monday night vs the Rams, Sept 21; he called it 'OK' pending X-rays); set the auto-sub before Nabers' own Sun 10 AM kickoff since Johnston plays the same slot.

Jones is Questionable (knee, sore Monday per coach Kevin O'Connell on Sept 21, who said he's expected to be fine Sunday); Judkins is a confirmed workhorse RB1 for Cleveland (Sept reports) and his Sun 10 AM kickoff is earlier than Jones' 1:05 PM, so full cover if set before Sun 10 AM.
